subject: reasoning
question: A is walking towards east. He takes 1 left turn and 1 right turn. In which direction he will be facing finally?
solution:
Start direction: East

From East, 1 left turn → North

From North, 1 right turn → East

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/21bf6660949a4c5600f7d77411200b26d3d7b825998908b82489b6b86ded9276.png] 

**Hence, the correct answer is option 2**
